what: A stage compacted every list of the image (O(image), 14 ms) every seventh edit of hello world: the jump table's cells are one piece whose rebase list names every filled slot, a body edit fills one slot and empties another, and the whole of the last list (12,000 entries) is garbage each time. Nothing said a compaction ran: it was inside `link patch`.
cost: 2 ms an edit on average and 14 ms every seventh, seen as `link patch` between 8 and 26 ms
cause: one threshold for seven lists, and a list re-pushed whole for one entry
state: fixed on edit2-1111: `link compact` is a span naming the list, and the loader's lists compact alone (a pass over the pieces); open: the cells' rebase list is still made whole by an edit that fills a slot
